[IAOT.2.4] **The pipeline supports GNU and LLVM toolchains alike.**
Both `gcc` and `clang` are supported drivers, for host and
cross-compilation, and neither is privileged: an integrator building
DS into an existing product must be able to use the toolchain that
product already uses.  The generated C is written to the common
subset both accept — `__builtin_*` intrinsics are spelled explicitly
and no driver-specific attribute or pragma is emitted.

The compiler used is configurable.  The default is the system `cc`.
Integrators may override via `DS_CC` environment variable or `--cc`
CLI flag.  The minimum required flags are `-O2 -fPIC -c`; additional
flags (e.g. `-march=native`, `-flto`) are integrator-configurable.

**The blob must be self-contained, so the driver's compiler-runtime
support library is linked in.**  On a soft-float target a `double`
compare or convert lowers to helpers (`__ltdf2`, `__gtdf2`,
`__floatdidf`) that a freestanding link does not otherwise supply.
That library is `libgcc` under GNU and `compiler-rt` under LLVM, so
the pipeline MUST select it from the driver rather than naming one of
them unconditionally.
